question: Should Telegram suppress all system-marked and compaction notice payloads, or only a narrower internal notice class while preserving configured `notifyUser` messages?
rationale: Current docs and a merged repair treat compaction notices as user-facing when opted in, so changing that contract requires maintainer product and compatibility intent rather than an automated patch guess.

options.title: Preserve configured notices
options.body: Keep `agents.defaults.compaction.notifyUser: true` delivering Telegram compaction notices and require a typed or narrower suppressor for the unwanted notice class.

options.title: Accept broad suppression
options.body: Allow Telegram to drop all compaction and gear-prefixed notices, but update the config/docs contract and provide upgrade-visible proof.

options.title: Pause until context is supplied
options.body: Hold the PR until the contributor explains the exact notice source and supplies Telegram proof showing the intended suppression boundary.

recommendation.title: Preserve configured notices
recommendation.body: Keep `agents.defaults.compaction.notifyUser: true` delivering Telegram compaction notices and require a typed or narrower suppressor for the unwanted notice class.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision affects the compaction notice contract introduced by feniix's merged feature work.
